title: Migrate task dialogs persistence to SQLite database (.cvh/harness.db)
diff_summary: 1. src-tauri/Cargo.toml: added rusqlite = { version = '0.32', features = ['bundled'] }. 2. src-tauri/src/db.rs: implemented SQLite database initialization at .cvh/harness.db (WAL mode, normal synchronous), dialog_items table with index idx_dialog_task, atomic batch insert/upsert (append_dialog_items), chronological loading (load_dialog_items), and task deletion (clear_dialog_items). 3. src-tauri/src/lib.rs: registered mod db. 4. src-tauri/src/commands.rs: switched save_task_dialog, load_task_dialog, clear_task_dialog to db module, removed dead JSON file helpers, added SQLite roundtrip unit test. 5. src/stores/drawerStore.ts: removed redundant heavy chat reading/writing to localStorage (cvh_dialog_<taskId>). 6. src-tauri/.cargo/config.toml: set CRATE_CC_NO_DEFAULTS = '1' to avoid Windows MSVC cc-rs error D8050.
notes: Task chat and activity items now persist cleanly to .cvh/harness.db. Fast-forward merged into main, worktree cleaned up, branch deleted.
